slides.title: Three myths about staying consistent
slides.body: Especially in weeks of broken nights.

slides.title: Consistent means the same workout daily
slides.body: Consistent can mean the same check daily. The workout can change.

slides.title: A missed session breaks the streak
slides.body: A planned rest day is part of the plan, not a gap in it.

slides.title: Short sessions don't add up
slides.body: Ten easy minutes is still movement you chose and finished.

slides.title: Track decisions, not sessions
slides.body: Did you check in and choose? Then you were consistent today.

slides.title: A steadier kind of consistency
